bull.point: Revenue grew 77.6% YoY, indicating rapid top-line expansion despite competitive pressure.
PAT surged 92.3% YoY, showing significant improvement in bottom-line profitability.
EBITDA margin reached 4.6%, up 0.2 pp YoY, confirming operational efficiency gains.
Debt/equity stands at 0.15, providing a conservative balance sheet for growth.

bear.point: Cumulative PAT loss of ₹949 cr over FY22–FY26 indicates persistent cash burn.
Debt/equity rose to 0.15 from 0.00, signaling increased financial leverage.
Analysts question if current interventions suffice to hold market share against well-capitalized rivals.
Concerns persist over user penetration saturation and retention impact from high competition.
